function: Joint learned channel prediction, BS hybrid precoding, passive RIS phase shifts, and UE digital combining to minimize transmit power under a rate threshold (p. 1, 6).
system: Point-to-point wideband RIS-aided THz mMIMO-OFDM: BS UPA with 256-1024 antennas and 8 RF chains, UE 8-16 antennas, passive reflecting RIS, 300 GHz (p. 3, 11).
method: Hierarchical DRL on a semi-Markov decision process: Mamba-GRU transformer (Mformer) option and action value networks, replay buffer; reinforcement learning, 3000 episodes (p. 7-12).
data_channel: Custom analytical THz channel from [32]: spreading and molecular-absorption loss, Markov blockage, coherence 0.99; no 3GPP model, public dataset, or measurements (p. 4, 5, 11).
test_conditions: Trained 3000 episodes in a simulated environment and evaluated in it while sweeping antennas, rate threshold, RF chains and power; no unseen-condition test stated (p. 11-14).
baselines: Learned only: DDPG hybrid beamforming [28] and WHRISNet [23]; no non-learned baseline compared (p. 11).
metrics: Transmit power (dBm), achievable rate, energy and spectral efficiency, channel-prediction NMSE, reward convergence in epochs (p. 12-14).
q1_support: p. 4: "We adopt the channel matrix and antenna spacing proposed in [32]" - an analytical THz model with spreading and molecular-absorption loss (Eqs. 1-2) and Markov blockage (p. 5); no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 12: "The training consists of 3000 episodes, with a maximum of 500 steps per episode" - one training environment; the sweeps over antennas, rate threshold and RF chains (Figs. 8-11, p. 12-14) are not stated as tests of a model trained elsewhere, and the scalability claim (p. 14) is qualitative.
q3_support: p. 11: "we consider the wideband hybrid reconfigurable intelligent surface network (WHRISNet) model in [23]" and "(DDPG) for hybrid beamforming in [28] is trained on the current environment and used as a baseline" - both are learned; no non-learned method (optimization, random or fixed RIS) is compared in Figs. 7-13.
q4_support: p. 12: "GAI-HDRL converges five times faster compared to DDPG" - training speed only; p. 10: "achieves linear complexity" is background on Mamba from [30]; no FLOPs, parameter count, order or runtime of the proposed method is reported.
q5_support: p. 12: "The version of Python is 3.12.3 and PyTorch version is 2.3.0" - software versions only; no link to code or data, simulated THz channel, no public dataset or measurements.
notes: Included, area 3: the main metrics are transmit power, achievable rate and energy efficiency (Figs. 8, 10-13) and the conclusion calls it a hybrid precoding scheme (p. 15), so the joint channel prediction, precoding and RIS design is graded by beamforming and not by the NMSE of Fig. 9 (area 2). q1=0: analytical THz model adopted from [32]. q2=0: no unseen-condition test. q3=0: both baselines are learned (DDPG [28], WHRISNet [23]) and no non-learned method is compared. q4=0: convergence five times faster than DDPG is training speed, and the Mamba linear-complexity statement is background from [30]; the reviewer may confirm. q5=0: no code link, simulated data.
